comment.body: This thread is for an agent session with openswe.

issue.description:
**Scope**
Scratch OAuth app with `actor=app`; mint a `client_credentials` token; delegate an issue; capture real created/prompted events; check retry timestamps, guest status, client-supplied activity id, and the undelegation event (design checks 1-7).

**Done when**
Every day-one check is answered; payloads saved as test fixtures.

References: [Design](<https://example.com/doc>) · [Work plan and success metrics](<https://example.com/doc>)
